subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` as the disabled-by-default canonical way to bound wedged deferred turn maintenance, or choose a different recovery policy before merge?
rationale: The code path is concrete and covered, but adding a new config key and releasing same-session maintenance on timeout are compatibility-sensitive product policy choices.

options.title: Accept This Opt-In Timeout
options.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive `turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` values as the operator-owned bound for wedged background maintenance.

options.title: Define A Different Policy
options.body: Pause this PR and specify a default, strict mode, or recovery behavior that avoids this config surface.

options.title: Use Another Branch
options.body: Close or retarget this PR only if maintainers choose an overlapping PR or replacement branch as the canonical timeout implementation.

recommendation.title: Accept This Opt-In Timeout
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the canonical fix and treat positive `turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` values as the operator-owned bound for wedged background maintenance.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and contributed to the background turn-maintenance feature and are the strongest available routing candidate for this config/session-state policy choice.
